name: getlib-mcp
description: GetLib MCP - powerful modular self-hostable library docs MCP server and dashboard (Context7 alternative)
author: D1ZZY4

scripts.check:no-em-dash: rg -lP "\x{2014}" --glob '!node_modules/**' --glob '!.next/**' --glob '!.git/**' --glob '!bun.lock' --glob '!AGENTS.md' . && echo 'EM DASH FOUND' && exit 1 || (rg -lP '\\u2014|—|—' src --glob '*.ts' --glob '*.tsx' --glob '*.css' && echo 'EM DASH CIRCUMVENTION FOUND' && exit 1 || echo 'no-em-dash: clean')
scripts.lint: bun run typecheck && bun run check:no-em-dash && bun run check:boundaries
scripts.validate: bun run typecheck && bun run check:no-em-dash && bun run check:boundaries && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.test: GET_LIB_MODE=development NODE_ENV=test VERCEL_ENV= VERCEL_URL= GETLIB_AUTHENTICATION_ENABLE=false GETLIB_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT= GETLIB_DEFAULT_PASS= GETLIB_SESSION_SECRET= GETLIB_DATABASE_MODE= GETLIB_SUPABASE_URL= GETLIB_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY= GETLIB_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY= GETLIB_SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY= SUPABASE_URL= SUPABASE_ANON_KEY= SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY= SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY= NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY= GETLIB_ALLOWED_HOSTS= GETLIB_CACHE_DIR= GETLIB_CONCURRENCY= GETLIB_NO_WATERMARK= GETLIB_GITHUB_TOKEN= GETLIB_TOKEN_LIMIT= GETLIB_MAX_TOKEN_LIMIT= GETLIB_CACHE_TTL_MS= GETLIB_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS= GETLIB_DEEP_FETCH_MAX_PAGES= GETLIB_DEEP_FETCH_RELEVANCE_THRESHOLD= GETLIB_DEEP_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS= GETLIB_MAX_CONCURRENT_FETCHES= GETLIB_TOOL_TIMEOUT_MS= GETLIB_SWR_STALE_TTL_MS= GETLIB_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD= GETLIB_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RESET_MS= GETLIB_LOG_FORMAT= GETLIB_LOG_LEVEL= bun test
